judgments.agentReasoning: The source evidence names travelers' checks, savings bonds, money orders, and cashier's checks. These are financial instruments or contractual products rather than tangible goods.
judgments.disagreementReason: Travelers checks, savings bonds, money orders, and cashier's checks are all embodied in physical objects, but these kinds of financial instruments are typically grouped in an industry called "Financial services," so they would be better classified under Sell service.
